title: UCSC HackNight
organizerUniversity: University of Colombo School of Computing
description: An overnight, fully remote hackathon aimed at first- and second-year students building their first real project. Lightweight rules, beginner-friendly problem statements, and live Discord mentoring throughout the night.
whoCanParticipate: First- and second-year undergraduates from any Sri Lankan university. No prior hackathon experience needed.
